headline: Names a New Orleans, Louisiana post office building after Dr. Rudy Lombard.
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 3901 MacArthur Blvd. in New Orleans, Louisiana, as the Dr. Rudy Lombard Post Office. It is a designation only and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing. The name change is made by Congress through the official bill.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 7, 2024.
